name: clean-miniflux
description: Miniflux, a maintained Go feed reader, used to measure false positives on clean code.

decoys.note: fmt.Sprintf builds the query, but the order column is passed through pq.QuoteIdentifier and all values are bound parameters.
Order column is quoted with pq.QuoteIdentifier before use in SQL.
Media proxy fetches a URL from the request, but only after verifying an HMAC signature made with the server's private key and restricting the scheme to http/https.
